summary: process point cloud data, filter lidar points, remove ground plane, detect clusters, 3D obstacle processing
description: Processes the latest 3D point cloud from lidar or depth camera. Command format: 'pointcloud_filter <mode>' where mode can be 'ground', 'clusters', 'obstacles', or 'downsample'. Output reports point counts, detected clusters, heights, and processing warnings. Report the key measurements for the chosen mode.
